major-00.meaning: A fresh start taken on faith. Step forward before you can see the whole path.

major-01.meaning: You already hold the tools you need. Direct your attention and make something real.

major-02.meaning: The answer is known quietly, beneath the noise. Listen inward before you act.

major-03.meaning: Things flourish when they are tended. Nourish what you love and let it take its time.

major-04.meaning: Order gives strength. Set firm boundaries and take responsibility for what is yours.

major-05.meaning: There is wisdom in what has been handed down. Learn the form before you decide whether to break it.

major-06.meaning: A bond or a decision that asks for your whole heart. Choose what matches your values.

major-07.meaning: Progress through discipline. Hold opposing forces together and keep moving.

major-08.meaning: Real strength is calm. Meet what is wild in you and around you with steady kindness.

major-09.meaning: Withdraw for a while to find your own counsel. The lamp you carry is enough for the next step.

major-10.meaning: The wheel turns whether you push it or not. What is rising will fall and what has fallen will rise.

major-11.meaning: What happens now follows from what came before. Weigh things honestly and accept the result.

major-12.meaning: Stop struggling and look again from another angle. Waiting is the work for now.

major-13.meaning: Something has run its course. Let it end cleanly so that what comes next has room.

major-14.meaning: Mix opposites slowly until they agree. The middle way is a skill, not a compromise.

major-15.meaning: Notice what has a hold on you. The chain is looser than it looks, and you can lift it off.

major-16.meaning: A false structure falls all at once. It is a shock, and it is also the truth arriving.

major-17.meaning: After the storm, clear water. Rest, heal, and trust that you are being restored.

major-18.meaning: The path is real but dimly lit. Move carefully and do not take every shadow for a threat.

major-19.meaning: Things are simply good. Enjoy the warmth and let yourself be seen.

major-20.meaning: A summons to rise and answer for your life. Forgive the past and step into the new chapter.

major-21.meaning: A long journey closes its circle. Celebrate what is finished before the next one begins.

wands-ace.meaning: A new idea catches fire. Act on it while it is hot.

wands-02.meaning: You have a foothold and a view of what lies beyond. Decide how far you mean to go.

wands-03.meaning: Your ships are out. Watch the horizon and prepare for what returns.

wands-04.meaning: A happy pause to mark what has been built. Gather your people and enjoy it.

wands-05.meaning: Everyone is pulling a different way. Treat the clash as practice, not as war.

wands-06.meaning: A public win. Accept the praise, and remember who rode beside you.

wands-07.meaning: You hold the high ground but must keep defending it. Stand firm in what you believe.

wands-08.meaning: Everything moves at once. Things land quickly now, so stay ready.

wands-09.meaning: You are tired and bruised but still standing. One more effort will carry it.

wands-10.meaning: You are carrying too much alone. Set some of it down or hand it on.

wands-page.meaning: An eager beginner with a bright idea. Follow your interest and see where it leads.

wands-knight.meaning: Charging ahead with fire and little patience. Bold action, best aimed before it is released.

wands-queen.meaning: Sure of herself and generous with her energy. Lead by being fully who you are.

wands-king.meaning: One who sees the goal and brings others to it. Take charge and set the direction.

cups-ace.meaning: The heart fills and overflows. Receive what is offered.

cups-02.meaning: Two people meet as equals. A bond is made or renewed.

cups-03.meaning: Joy shared among friends. Raise a glass with the people who lift you.

cups-04.meaning: Boredom has narrowed your view. Look up, because something is being held out to you.

cups-05.meaning: You mourn what has spilled. When you are ready, turn and see what still stands.

cups-06.meaning: A sweetness from the past returns. Give and receive simply, as a child would.

cups-07.meaning: Many tempting visions, and not all of them real. Choose one and test it against the ground.

cups-08.meaning: What you built no longer satisfies. Leave it in good order and go looking for more.

cups-09.meaning: You have what you wanted. Sit back and enjoy it without apology.

cups-10.meaning: Deep, shared peace at home. This is the kind of happiness that holds.

cups-page.meaning: A gentle surprise from the heart. Stay open to feelings that arrive unannounced.

cups-knight.meaning: Someone arrives with an offer and an open heart. Follow the feeling, with your eyes open.

cups-queen.meaning: She feels deeply and holds it steadily. Care for others without losing yourself.

cups-king.meaning: Calm on a moving sea. Lead with feeling that is mastered, not suppressed.

swords-ace.meaning: A clean, sharp insight cuts through the confusion. Name the thing plainly.

swords-02.meaning: You have closed your eyes to a decision. It will wait, but it will not leave.

swords-03.meaning: It hurts, and it is honest. Let the grief move through you so it does not settle in.

swords-04.meaning: Lay down your arms for a while. Healing needs quiet.

swords-05.meaning: You may win the argument and lose the people. Ask whether this fight is worth its cost.

swords-06.meaning: A quiet passage away from trouble. Sad to go, and right to go.

swords-07.meaning: Someone is trying to slip away with more than their share. Check what is being left unsaid, including by you.

swords-08.meaning: The bonds are mostly your own thoughts. Take one step and the way out appears.

swords-09.meaning: Fears are loudest in the dark. Say them aloud in daylight and they shrink.

swords-10.meaning: It is over and it cannot get worse. The sky is already lightening behind you.

swords-page.meaning: Alert, questioning, quick with words. Learn everything, and think before you speak.

swords-knight.meaning: Rushing in with total certainty. Fast and forceful, so be sure of your aim.

swords-queen.meaning: She sees clearly and says so. Be kind and truthful, and keep your boundaries.

swords-king.meaning: A clear mind in command. Decide by principle and reason, not mood.

pentacles-ace.meaning: A solid chance is placed in your hand. Plant it and tend it.

pentacles-02.meaning: You are keeping several things in the air. Stay light on your feet and it will hold.

pentacles-03.meaning: Good work made with others. Your skill is noticed and it improves in company.

pentacles-04.meaning: You are gripping what you have very tightly. Safety is good, but a closed hand receives nothing.

pentacles-05.meaning: A lean, cold stretch. Help is closer than it feels, so ask for it.

pentacles-06.meaning: Resources move from those who have to those who need. Notice which side you are on today.

pentacles-07.meaning: Pause and look at what your work has grown. Decide whether to keep tending it.

pentacles-08.meaning: Head down, one piece after another. Skill is built by repetition.

pentacles-09.meaning: You have earned a graceful life by your own effort. Enjoy the garden you planted.

pentacles-10.meaning: Something built to outlast you. Security that is shared across generations.

pentacles-page.meaning: A student with a practical dream. Start small and learn the craft properly.

pentacles-knight.meaning: Slow, thorough and dependable. Keep going and the work will be finished.

pentacles-queen.meaning: She makes a home wherever she is. Care for body, household and budget with equal warmth.

pentacles-king.meaning: Success made tangible and shared. Manage what you have well, and be generous with it.
